_comment: CK's Pi Code Agent Harness configuration. Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation only; every other key must have a consumer in code (tests/test_governance.py::test_no_zombie_harness_config_keys).
_usableContextTokens: Usable context ceiling in tokens, NOT the engine's -c value. 0 disables (default: trust the declared contextWindow). Set it to where your model still behaves: measure with scripts/probe-tool-calls.mjs. On this machine's 27B models, 20,100 tokens scored 8/8 clean and 23,083 scored 6/8, so ~26000 leaves compaction firing at ~19,500. Caps models.json contextWindow and derives settings.json compaction.
_perTurnPromptTokens: Fixed per-turn prompt (system prompt + tool schemas) in tokens. 0 = unknown. Measure it: PI_HARNESS_DUMP_PROMPT=<file> pi --print "Reply with exactly: OK", then tokenize. It is a floor under the post-compaction context, so compaction must land below the trigger WITH it included; ignoring it produces settings that compact every turn.
